boundaries.interpretation: Execution-weighted records include repeated visits across queries; unique pair counts are also reported. First non-descent is the first visited state with no strictly lower predicted legal successor. A cycle-closing action is inspected after selection. Positive optimal-vs-other margin favors the best teacher-optimal child; ties depend on the unchanged candidate order. No evaluation record is added to training.
